subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-10-23
html:
Weekly Pulse — Oct 23, 2026

~16 weeks since kickoff (2026-07-04). Fresh live pull, site_id 12704162.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending. GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing on the live site, but this sandbox has no outbound access to the GA4 reporting API, so conversions can't be pulled from here. A scheduled data Action (outside this sandbox) fills this number in later — until then, leading indicators below (rank, backlinks, AI visibility) are the only available signal.

All 22 tracked keywords sat at the not-ranked floor (avg position 100) every single day this period (10/16→10/23), Google USA — unchanged since tracking began 2026-08-01, now 21 straight sessions flat.

Traffic vs last week

No change. SE Ranking's domain overview still returns no ranking keywords for askarlo.app in the US index — no organic footprint to measure traffic from yet, same as every prior pulse.

Anything broken?

No. All 55 SEO Report Email runs since kickoff are green, 55/55 all-time, zero failures (confirmed directly via GitHub Actions — Thursday's 2026-10-22 persona-page heading fix, run #55, shipped cleanly). Backlinks flat at 3 / 2 referring domains, unchanged since 2026-09-10 (9th straight week flat). AI Result Tracker still has zero LLM engines configured — no AI-visibility baseline exists; this remains a human decision in SE Ranking before AI-citation movement can be tracked at all.

Reading the week

Another quiet pulse — nothing moved and nothing broke. Rank and backlinks stay flat for the same reasons as every recent pulse: both content engines (connector matrix 5/5, comparison hub 5/5, blog 10 posts) are fully built against current keyword demand, and the levers that would actually move these numbers — GSC sitemap submission, off-page Phase 1 link-building (0/6 registries), and the catalog.ts connectors past their ETAs — stay human-gated. One thing worth watching next pulse: the shareable_dashboard destination's "October 2026" ETA is now in the final week of the month without flipping from coming_soon — if it lapses, it joins the rest of the past-due list. Thursday's session (10-22) already shipped this week's one code fix, a leftover agency-copy cleanup on the persona-page template; no new issue surfaced today.
